name: AI Business Intelligence & Weekly Report System

parameters.subject: =BI Report Sent - {{ $('Format HTML Report').item.json.week_start }} | {{ $('Format HTML Report').item.json.total_orders }} orders | ₹{{ $('Format HTML Report').item.json.total_revenue }}

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.item.json; // Format currency const formatINR = (amount) => '₹' + Number(amount).toLocaleString('en-IN'); // Format trends section const trendsHtml = (d.top_trends || []).map(t => ` ${t.impact === 'positive' ? '▲' : '▼'} ${t.trend}
Data point: ${t.data_point} `).join(''); // Format anomalies const anomaliesHtml = (d.anomalies || []).map(a => `
  • ⚠ ${a}
    • `).join(''); // Format recommendations const rec1 = d.recommendation_1 || {}; const rec2 = d.recommendation_2 || {}; const htmlReport = `

    Weekly Business Intelligence Report

    Week of ${d.week_start} to ${d.week_end}

    Executive Summary

    ${d.executive_summary}

    Key Metrics This Week

    ${formatINR(d.total_revenue)}
    Total Revenue
    ${d.total_orders}
    Total Orders
    ${formatINR(d.avg_order_value)}
    Avg Order Value
    ${d.avg_rating} ★
    Avg Rating

    Top Trends This Week

    ${trendsHtml}

    ⚠ Anomalies & Watch Points

      ${anomaliesHtml}

    Customer Sentiment

    ${d.customer_sentiment?.overall || 'N/A'}

    ${d.customer_sentiment?.summary || ''}

    Support Health

    ${d.support_health?.status || 'N/A'}

    ${d.support_health?.summary || ''}

    Open tickets: ${d.open_tickets} | Top issue: ${d.top_issue_category}

    🎯 This Week's Action Items

    1. ${rec1.action || ''}
    ${rec1.detail || ''}
    2. ${rec2.action || ''}
    ${rec2.detail || ''}

    This report was automatically generated by your AI Business Intelligence System.
    Top category this week: ${d.top_category}

    `; return { json: { ...d, html_report: htmlReport, report_title: `BI Report: Week of ${d.week_start}`, run_timestamp: new Date().toISOString() } };
